authorization: Previously approved closure plan; resumed author request to finish experiments. No manuscript change, hardware substitution or submission authorized by this contract.

scope.reference_architecture: Pipeline at 1000 m, dedicated vertical ingress to collection gateways at 500 m, original shared surface infrastructure.
scope.interpretation: Source-informed finite-resource simulation. Declared link, electrical, memory and manoeuvre hypotheses are not commercial hardware calibration or complete embedded implementation certification.

manifest.review: Root numerical review before any new network pilot: original nominal geometry and91798.03-s horizon retained. The longer corridor uses that same fixed horizon, explicitly differing from the old179596.06-s long run so duration is not changed with length. Electrical/link hypotheses are distinguished from manufacturer facts; no policy outcomes used for parameter choice.

acoustic.service_mode: TS5 service-rate scale, not MDFT waveform reproduction
acoustic.fixed_range_scope: Maximum role gate only, not a universal radius; BSN/DRN remain300m as listed below.
acoustic.power_provenance: Fixed study hypotheses, not measured commercial modem draw; same values for shared D/H owners.
acoustic.frame_and_ack_model: 512-B application fragments; reviewed HIGH/MED header51 B and LOW75 B, lower ns-3 framing explicitly additional. Half-duplex PHY ledger, real reverse record ACK51+16 B, encoded control61 B+body. Retry candidate r permits r+1 attempts over a leg lifetime. ACK grace12s begins after observed local PHY completion; explicit local refusals settle the attempt/retry directly. Silent lower-MAC stalls retain the hard record deadline, not a guaranteed ACK-latency bound.
acoustic.channel_provenance: 27-kHz absorption approximation, 60-dB study link margin and fixed role gates, modeled ALOHA; no calibrated Sonardyne BER or automatic range enlargement.

optical.sleep_provenance: Optical interfaces are switched off outside finite sessions; shared host and acoustic sleep/idle draw remain on their owner ledger. This is a power-gated study policy, not measured vendor standby draw.
optical.channel_model: Timed one-way optical DATA, conservative continuous moving-contact gate; nominal whole-frame probability1 and declared perturbation0.9. Actual existing acoustic interfaces carry finite wake/credit and confirmation. No second optical pair, Gaussian UV calibration or free reverse ACK.
optical.engineering_parameters: 1-s startup, 30-s listen window, 5-s poll, 12-s ACK grace, 0.01-s turnaround, 3 lifetime attempts, 4096 receipt slots and8-MiB receive credit; all specified before policy outcomes.

vehicle.energy_model_status: Single finite owner shared by operation, radio and optical interfaces. Baseline900W is a study assumption at published endurance scale, not a fitted propulsion curve. External recovery600s/540kJ is explicitly charged.
vehicle.certified_route_catalogue: Software-checked continuous constant-speed route primitives, 100-m horizontal turn radius, 50-m minimum 3D radius and finite-pitch/depth constraints; static and adaptive use the same primitives. Certification here means mathematical constraint checking only, not vehicle field qualification.
vehicle.return_and_offload_geometry: Existing surface sinks served by submerged finite-radius moving paths. Original first-sink rendezvous at50m is home. Every admitted action retains service/return/recovery and reserve budget; no recharge or surface teleport. H-A uses one/two collection candidates followed by offload and return, selected from received encoded reports only.

workload.cohorts: All complete acquisitions released before the fixed horizon are generated. Complete-window misses use the mature cohort; later generated backlog remains reported separately.

storage_and_ingress.working_ram_scope: Dedicated cable staging RAM at each endpoint, not total embedded RAM.
storage_and_ingress.allocation_provenance: Proposed semantic allocations, not inferred manufacturer RAM. Vehicle usable payload allocation deducts source/RX control slots, optical receipts/sessions and adaptive report cache. Generic lower MAC memory is not certified by these application bounds.
storage_and_ingress.dedicated_ingress_medium: One finite powered serial-service abstraction per site, common nonpreemptive priority admission for HIGH/MED/LOW; not a qualified SMART-native500m RS485 link.
storage_and_ingress.retention_and_backpressure: Source retains its physical copy until actual returned cable ACK after durable gateway commit; a committed backup is not counted as a second unique record. Finite archive, staging and persistent outbox; bounded retries, mission-long retention, explicit refusal/expiry/depletion. HIGH/MED upstream acoustic sender confirms only after cable confirmation.
storage_and_ingress.cable_termination_and_power_evidence: 500m/2e8m/s propagation, 10 wire bits/byte, 16-B DATA/ACK descriptors plus LOW24B, 10-ms durable write and1-ms turnaround study hypotheses. Source logger budget4.32MJ, baseline0.2W, cable TX0.2/RX0.1W; gateway cable TX0.2/RX0.1W from its existing owner. No parallel cable or hidden battery.
